name: GL_PACS_DEFINITIONS
description: This table contains definitions of partial account combination sets. A partial account combination set validates segment value combinations for at least two segments. Any segment for a chart of accounts can be included in the definition.

columns.name: PACS_DEFINITION_ID
columns.description: Partial account combination set unique identifier.

columns.name: PACS_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: The name of the partial account combination set.

columns.name: PACS_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: The description of the partial account combination set.

columns.name: CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS_ID
columns.description: Chart of accounts associated with the partial account combination set.

columns.name: VALIDATION_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Code that indicates whether account combination that matches a partial account combination should be considered a valid combination or an invalid combination. Valid values are ORA_ALLOW and ORA_DISALLOW.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the partial account combination set is available for use.

columns.name: SEGMENT_COLUMN1
columns.description: Segment column that contains the first segment used in the partial account combination set. Valid values are from SEGMENT1 through SEGMENT30.

columns.name: SEGMENT_COLUMN2
columns.description: Segment column that contains the second segment used in the partial account combination set. Valid values are from SEGMENT1 through SEGMENT30.

columns.name: SEGMENT_COLUMN3
columns.description: Segment column that contains the third segment used in the partial account combination set, if there is one. Valid values are from SEGMENT1 through SEGMENT30.

columns.name: SEGMENT_COLUMN4
columns.description: Segment column that contains the fourth segment used in the partial account combination set, if there is one. Valid values are from SEGMENT1 through SEGMENT30.

columns.name: SEGMENT_COLUMN5
columns.description: Segment column that contains the fifth segment used in the partial account combination set, if there is one. Valid values are from SEGMENT1 through SEGMENT30.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
